task.title: L12.23 DOM Intelligence deterministic coverage expansion: implement, verify, close
task.objective: Owner request of 2026-10-05: implement awkit-djnl.21.23. Layer 2 mutation coverage on the existing L10.0 fixtures with a verifier-only oracle (recover the target or refuse, never a wrong element), then Layer 1 (Test Lab fixtures), Layer 3 (Element Spy similar rows and loops, protected-login detection and its navigation cost, the Super-User read-time challenge check) and Layer 4 (sanitized enterprise stand-ins). Gate: 50-100 cases, 0 wrong, removed targets empty, 11/14 kept, 3 identical runs, budgets as guardrails, mock-site docs and verify:mock-site, verifier registered, mutation controls. The coverage found three wrong-element recoveries, fixed with the pre-existing-twin veto in LocatorFactory. Close .21.23 with its evidence and file the remaining findings as .21.24. L12.22 is not touched.
